details: This package is an install-time beacon / proof-of-concept test artifact, not a functional library: index.js only exports a stub that returns a placeholder string. Its package.json declares a preinstall hook running node preinstall.js, which on every install sends an HTTP POST to a Discord webhook (hxxps://canary[.]discord[.]com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/[secret-redacted]) with the JSON body {"content":"Run on <hostname> as <os username> at <timestamp>","username":"PC Notifier"}, i.e. it reports the machine hostname, the local OS username, the install timestamp and the npm lifecycle event name. It then writes a local marker file.preinstall-marker.json into the package directory recording whether the webhook call succeeded. No credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are collected or transmitted, and the code runs no child processes and no decoded/dynamic code.
